summary: Added 'unknown' to checks_state so a transient CI-lookup error no longer drives a phantom rework or an unverified merge; all gates green, fix proven by a regression test on the real error path.

commits: Treat a transient CI-status lookup error as unknown, not failing
Add issue #29 thoughts trail (requirements, research, plan, execution)
details.confirmation_policy: P0 (no confirmation-before-rework) — resolved in planning, honored in execution; a genuine successfully-read failing check still reworks immediately, only the lookup error becomes unknown. Owner-delegated, so not surfaced for confirmation.
details.plan_divergence: Added `unknown: 0` to combineCheckStates' exhaustive priority Record (a pure typecheck consequence of widening ChecksState; combineCheckStates is never called with unknown, so no behavior change) — not called out in the plan.
details.regression_proof: Temporarily reverted the catch to return 'failing'; both getPRStatus catch-path tests failed (expected 'failing' to be 'unknown'), confirming they drive the real error path. Restored immediately.
